2026-08-18.summary:
### Vehicle & Siege Weapon Fixes
- Catapults now correctly reset their loaded ammo after firing.  
- Helicopters start with proper rotor speed on spawn.  
- Siege weapons (e.g., ballistae) properly reset after use, preventing lingering states.  
- Vehicle seat ownership is now cleared when a seat is pooled, fixing occasional seat‑ownership glitches.  

### Monument & Map Adjustments
- Monument blockers no longer grant bonus resource rates; melee time‑to‑kill and resource yields have been balanced for consistency.  
- Jungle Ziggurat treatment tank now uses a single mesh collider, improving performance and collision accuracy.  
- Static chairs on the gas station roof are now mountable again.  

### AI & Navmesh Overhaul
- Independent navmeshes now respect monument boundaries and build correctly, eliminating AI navigation errors.  
- Scientists (including cargo, underwater lab, and oilrig variants) now spawn and move reliably in all locations.  
- Old‑style scientists’ steering behavior fixed; they now turn instantly instead of wobbling.  
- Scientist2 crouch‑walk angle on Oilrig corrected.  

### Weapon & Item Enhancements
- Honey bandage now reliably applies its healing effect.  
- Flashlight model updated: orientation matches the viewmodel, toggleable in‑game, and AO texture reduced for better performance.  
- Machete animation refreshed for smoother swings.  
- Salvaged hammer textures optimized (AO reduced) and third‑person positioning corrected.  
- Laserlight and muzzle‑brake/boost models receive LOD improvements, reducing pop‑in at close range.  
- Radial blur added to the rendering pipeline and vignette effect toned down for a cleaner visual experience.  

### New Animals & Pets
- Livestock expansion: cows and sheep now spawn with distinct male/female prefabs; sheep feature a sleeping animation and no longer move while asleep.  
- Dog assets fully integrated (models, materials, animations, harnesses), bringing updated canine appearances and behavior.  

### UI & Visual Polish
- Tutorial modal size fixed, background cleaned up, and fully localized text added.  
- Connection modal description corrected and streamlined.  
- Icon fonts auto‑cleaned on exit and now generate only needed glyphs, reducing memory usage.

2026-08-17.summary:
## Animals & Breeding
- **Bull** added as a new livestock animal.
- All livestock now include both male and female variants, and a breeding state machine has been introduced, enabling animal breeding.

## Deployables & Monument Updates
- **CCTV cameras** and **windmills** are now functional in the world.
- **Water wheel** has been added/updated.
- **Tesla coil**, **solar panel**, and **fuel generator** assets have been cleaned up for more reliable operation.

## Visual & Rendering Improvements
- Underwater laboratory windows now show proper refraction textures.
- Rooms stay visible while doors are closing, preventing brief disappearances.
- New **white boomer firework** variant added for a fresh visual effect.

## UI & Server Browser Updates
- Servers with Nexus enabled are now tagged in the server list; zone servers can be hidden (optional).
- Connect‑modal map button works correctly for Nexus paths, and overall Nexus UI has been refined.
- Max‑players count now displays accurately after recent changes.
- F1 menu categories are sorted alphabetically for easier navigation.

## Gameplay Fixes & Performance
- Water bucket UI bug fixed – you can now transfer water into a held bucket.
- Honey bandage now correctly triggers its healing effects.
- Server‑side planner bone hierarchy culled, reducing server load and improving performance.
- Optimized room visibility handling reduces unnecessary network updates.
